plugins.name: ai-toolkit-dev
plugins.description: Toolkit for authoring Claude Code plugins, marketplaces, and skills. Ships 3 skills covering the plugin manifest, marketplace schema, and skill creation. Work in progress.

plugins.name: project-setup
plugins.description: Architectural decision-maker for repos, new and existing — repo layout, service boundaries, per-app stack and database choice, docker / compose, env and secrets, frontend structure, deployment. Ships 1 skill with three modes reached from plain language: init, audit, suggest. Composes with the sibling agent-ks and uvenv plugins.

plugins.name: agent-ks
plugins.description: Operating manual for the agent-knowledge-system framework: markdown docs, blog posts, site configuration, themes, the folder-per-issue tracker, and self-contained HTML artifacts. Ships eight skills, four of them commands (init, add-section, quick-idea-note, index-check), a read-only index-checking agent, and the `agent-ks` CLI. Requires bun.

plugins.name: uvenv
plugins.description: Operating manual for uvenv — a bash/zsh wrapper around mise + uv that adds conda-style named global Python venvs you can activate from any directory. Covers the command grammar, the four environment kinds, migrating off conda, and doctor-first diagnostics.
